Provision 5.4.1-2 (Principle 11), p. 14, uses should: developers treat major updates as a new model version. Document V2.1.1 (2025-12).

Action 1, p. 2 (per fetch; pp. 2-3 span): diverse internal and independent external testing incl. red teaming, secure environments, multiple points with emphasis before deployment/placement. No date stated.

Section 2 subsection on attackers finding ways to elicit harmful behaviour: adversarial training has gaps, new attacks succeed; safeguards hard to evaluate under realistic conditions. Published 25 Nov 2025.

what_source_says: Principle 8: statistically sound test plans, clinically relevant data independent of training data, intended population, subgroups, confounders. FDA/Health Canada/MHRA, Oct 2021.
Section on application to aircraft certification, p. 16 of 31: stress testing at item level for V&V, additional tests at system and aircraft level for failure analysis. Version I, no issue date.

Section Model Validation: validation involves a degree of independence; generally by staff not responsible for development or use. Issued 4 Apr 2011, updated 19 Aug 2011. Section name now seen though row says locator not seen (not an error).

Section 2.4 (Evaluate Challenges in AI-OT System Integration) is on page 16 of 25 per fetch; row says p. 15 (may be printed vs PDF page). Content, wording and date (3 Dec 2025, initial version) match. Failsafe and test infrastructure are separate sub-points.

what_source_says: Principle 4: training and test datasets appropriately independent; sources of dependence incl. patient, acquisition and site factors considered. Published 27 Oct 2021, updated 5 Oct 2026.
Section says agencies are required to submit to the AI Review Committee when risk is high or critical; applies to all NSW Government agencies; no version/date; platform mandatory 30 Sep 2026.
Section IV-1-2 (fairness and bias), p. 23, v1.0, March 2025: since indicators and audit procedures are not clearly defined, a consistent framework to detect and address bias early is needed.

Slide 11: reuse of evaluation data may cause unnoticed optimisation; safeguards: model improvement process assuming reuse, small separate dataset to check generalisation, cap on uses. Document undated.

Section 2(a) Fairness, p. 3, circular dated 19 Aug 2024 to all Authorized Institutions: avoid unfair bias; measures include masking/excluding sensitive categories, representative training data, correcting bias in validation and review. "Anonymising" is a loose rendering of masking, not meaning changing.
